title: Shot spec
description: One shot of a film: the source of truth that an engine backend compiles into its own scene file and renders (D-028, D-030). Lives at films/<film>/shots/<id>/shot.json and as an item of the shot list. Times are seconds from the start of the shot. Positions are fractions of the frame: [0, 0] top-left, [1, 1] bottom-right. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (events inside the shot, characters in dialogue present in the shot) are checked by studio_core.schema.check_shot.

duration_s.description: Length of the shot in seconds.

characters.description: Characters in the shot, back to front.

music_cue.description: Music cue id (audio/music/<id>.wav), or null for none. Plays from the start of the shot, ducked under dialogue.

music_volume.description: Music level before ducking; 1 = as loud as the dialogue.

notes.description: Free text for humans and the director; ignored by tools.

id.description: Lowercase identifier: letters, digits, underscores; starts with a letter.

time_s.description: Seconds from the start of the shot.

frame_pos.description: [x, y] as fractions of the frame: [0, 0] top-left, [1, 1] bottom-right.

camera.description: Camera for the whole shot. Omitted = static, zoom 1.

duration_s.description: Defaults to the rest of the shot.

position.description: Where the character stands: the point between its feet (the lowest point of its rest pose), as fractions of the frame. [0.5, 0.92] = centre, standing near the bottom.

facing.description: Mirror the character to face left. While a walk_cycle runs and the character moves sideways along its path, it faces the direction of travel.

path.description: Where the character moves during the shot: waypoints in time order. It stands at `position` until the first segment begins; each waypoint is reached from the one before it (the start position for the first) with the waypoint's easing. Two waypoints at the same position make it hold still.

waypoint.description: The character is at `position` at time_s, arriving with `ease`.

time_s.description: Seconds from the start of the shot; strictly increasing along the path, no later than the end of the shot.

position.description: Where its feet are, as for `position`.

ease.description: How the segment ending here accelerates: linear = constant speed; ease_in = starts slow; ease_out = ends slow; ease_in_out = both.

action.description: A named motion from the motion library, starting at start_s.

duration_s.description: Defaults to the motion's natural length.

side.description: Which arm/side, from the character's point of view.

target.description: Where to point or look, in the frame.

pose.description: A manual key pose: bone angle offsets from the rest pose, in degrees.

line.description: A dialogue line. Its audio is audio/dialogue/<line_id>.wav, its mouth cues audio/lipsync/<line_id>.json.

query.description: What it should sound like, in words (kept for humans and for re-searching).

sound.description: The library sound chosen for the query (find_sfx). Not set yet = silent, with a warning.
